dict.string: Auralim uses your location and bundled offline time-zone boundaries to calculate local sunrise and sunset while traveling. If location is unavailable, it uses your saved manual city.
Auralim uses your location and bundled offline time-zone boundaries to calculate local sunrise and sunset while traveling. If location is unavailable, it uses your saved manual city.
Auralim needs to control System Events to switch system appearance at locally calculated sunrise and sunset times.
